title: Add discovered server
description: Create a server profile from a discovered mount.
configurationHelp: This install folder has more than one server config (.ini) file. Pick the one whose settings — name, RCON port, mods — you want the panel to use. You can add the others later from Server Setup.
displayNameHelp: Just a label shown in this panel's server list. It does not rename any files or change the server's actual name in-game.
